text: A melancholic and slow-tempo sad rock piece in 4/4 time. The composition features heavy, sustained electric guitar chords and a prominent minor key melody. Spanning 16 bars with a duration of 45 seconds, the arrangement emphasizes a downward melodic contour to evoke deep sorrow.

This sad rock track is characterized by a mid-tempo drive and a 3/4 waltz-like rhythm. It spans 24 bars and utilizes a wide pitch range of 4 octaves, featuring a clean guitar arpeggio that creates a sense of loneliness and emotional weight over 60 seconds.

An intense sad rock ballad in a minor key with a highly syncopated rhythm. The music lasts for 35 seconds across 12 bars, focusing on high-velocity drum hits and distorted power chords that convey a sense of frustration and grief.

This somber composition is a slow sad rock instrumental featuring a descending bassline. It plays for 50 seconds and covers 16 bars. The use of a small pitch range and soft dynamics creates an intimate, reflective atmosphere typical of modern alternative rock.

A dark and atmospheric sad rock track with a 6/8 time signature. The melody is centered in a low register, spanning 20 bars and 55 seconds. The rhythmic pattern is steady yet heavy, utilizing long-duration notes to enhance the feeling of despair.

A short, impactful sad rock segment of 15 seconds. It features a high-pitched, weeping lead guitar solo in a minor scale. Spanning 8 bars, the rhythm is rubato-style, giving the music a fragile and unpredictable emotional quality.

This track is a mid-tempo sad rock anthem with a rich harmonic structure in a natural minor key. It spans 32 bars and plays for 70 seconds, featuring a layered arrangement of acoustic and electric guitars that builds emotional tension.

A minimalist sad rock piece focusing on a repetitive, mournful piano and guitar motif. It spans 16 bars with a duration of 40 seconds. The sparse rhythm and low note density highlight the emptiness and 'sad' character of the rock subgenre.

This sad rock song features a driving 4/4 beat with a moderate tempo but maintains a gloomy mood through its flat-six and flat-seven chord progressions. It spans 28 bars and lasts 65 seconds, utilizing a broad 5-octave pitch range.

An experimental sad rock track in 5/4 time signature, creating a restless and uneasy feeling. The composition lasts for 48 seconds over 18 bars, using dissonance and muted guitar strokes to articulate a complex sense of sadness.
